{{Quote|We consider our selves neutral in this war, but we will do what we must for the good of our economy.|Harko Vane|<ref name="tcw10">[[The Clone Wars 10|''The Clone Wars'' 10]]</ref>}}
'''Harko Vane''', a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], was the [[King]] and [[Viscount]] of [[Valahari/Legends|Valahari]], a member of the [[House of Vane]], a close friend of [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count of Serenno]], and the father of [[Tofen Vane/Legends|Tofen Vane]].

==Biography==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Vane declined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] ultimatum to stop supplying weapons to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and was soon [[Death/Legends|killed]] after his [[Transport/Legends|transport]], the [[Valiant (transport)|''Valiant'']], was secretly sabotaged by Dooku's best [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] and secret [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], in an effort to frame the Republic and [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] for the crime and pull the House of Vane over to the Separatists' side.

In revenge for his father's death, his son [[Tofen Vane/Legends|Tofen]] engaged the Republic forces in battle, profiling himself as a fighter ace, but [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who greatly respected Tofen, managed to raise doubts about Harko's demise. In the end, Dooku's duplicity was discovered and the Count banished from the House by Harko's widow [[Elodore Vane|Elodore]].
